* header: ctx 42%/200k = the context the next prompt will carry, over the window (70% warns, 90% is
| critical); a * on the percentage — ctx 42%*/200k — means that figure is an estimate, not a
| provider count
* header: ctx ? = nothing measured yet; after a compression it reads ctx ? · compacted until a reply
| re-measures the count
* header: ↑12k ↓3.4k = tokens in and out this session · R18k W2.0k = cache tokens read and written
| this session
* header: CH 75% = the share of the LAST prompt that came from cache · CH n/a = the provider does
| not report cache traffic, so the rate is unknowable rather than zero · CH — = it does report it
| and nothing is cached yet
* header: $1.42 = estimated cost at list prices; $1.42+ is a lower bound, because the session moved
| tokens the model registry does not price
* header: plan = plan mode is on: writes, edits and shell are denied; absent means mutations are
| allowed
* header: the last segment is the model; a final offline means no provider credentials are
| configured and the scripted provider is answering
* goal: /goal <objective> parks one long-running objective in this session; the header line shows
| its phase and rounds
